tests: Document-level metadata failures in isolation: no title, no declared language, and mixed natural languages requiring a language change marker on a passage.
adversarialFeatures: no <title> element, so the PDF should carry no document title
body text in two natural languages
a French block quotation inside an otherwise English document
headings are styled divs, carrying no semantics even in the source
expectedTitleAfterRemediation: Cannot be derived deterministically from metadata because none exists. The visible first line 'Notice de conformité — Compliance Notice' is the only candidate, and using it is an inference, not a deterministic fix.
expectedLanguage: en, with the French passages carrying their own language marker
intentionalProblems: language changes within the body that need per-passage marking
relevantMatterhornConditions: 7.2-34 natural language for text shall be determined
7.1-8 catalog shall contain a Metadata key
